question: How many lecturers taught AIMS Cameroon students during the 2018-19 academic year and from how many countries?
answer: During the Academic Year 2018-19 , 37 students of the AIMS Cameroon Structured Master's Program were taught by 25 lecturers from 10 countries (Australia, Austria, Cameroon, DRC, France, Gambia, Germany, Greece, Italy and the UK).
